description: Get information (values, states, …) from Helm package deployed inside the cluster.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: Token used to authenticate with the API. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_API_KEY environment variable.

parameters.name: binary_path
parameters.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

parameters.name: ca_cert
parameters.description: Path to a CA certificate used to authenticate with the API. The full certificate chain must be provided to avoid certificate validation errors. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_SSL_CA_CERT environment variable.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Helm option to specify which kubeconfig context to use. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable K8S_AUTH_CONTEXT will be used instead.

parameters.name: get_all_values
parameters.description: Set to True if you want to get all (computed) values of the release. When False (default), only user supplied values are returned. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: Provide a URL for accessing the API. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_HOST environment variable.

parameters.name: kubeconfig
parameters.description: Helm option to specify kubeconfig path to use. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable K8S_AUTH_KUBECONFIG will be used instead. The configuration can be provided as dictionary. Added in version 2.4.0.

parameters.name: release_namespace
parameters.description: Kubernetes namespace where the chart should be installed.

parameters.name: release_state
parameters.description: Show releases as per their states. Default value is deployed and failed. If set to all, show all releases without any filter applied. If set to deployed, show deployed releases. If set to failed, show failed releases. If set to pending, show pending releases. If set to superseded, show superseded releases. If set to uninstalled, show uninstalled releases, if helm uninstall --keep-history was used. If set to uninstalling, show releases that are currently being uninstalled. Default: []

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to verify the API server’s SSL certificates. Can also be specified via K8S_AUTH_VERIFY_SSL environment variable. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Gather information of Grafana chart inside monitoring namespace
  kubernetes.core.helm_info:
    name: test
    release_namespace: monitoring

- name: Gather information about test-chart with pending state
  kubernetes.core.helm_info:
    name: test-chart
    release_namespace: testenv
    release_state:
    - pending

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: A dictionary of status output Returned: only when release exists

return_values.name: app_version
return_values.description: Version of app deployed Returned: always

return_values.name: chart
return_values.description: Chart name and chart version Returned: always

return_values.name: hooks
return_values.description: Hooks of the release Returned: always

return_values.name: manifest
return_values.description: Manifest of the release Returned: always

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the release Returned: always

return_values.name: namespace
return_values.description: Namespace where the release is deployed Returned: always

return_values.name: notes
return_values.description: Notes of the release Returned: always

return_values.name: release_values
return_values.description: Dict of Values used to deploy. Returned: always

return_values.name: revision
return_values.description: Number of time where the release has been updated Returned: always

return_values.name: updated
return_values.description: The Date of last update Returned: always

return_values.name: values
return_values.description: Dict of Values used to deploy This return value has been deprecated and will be removed in a release after 2027-01-08. Use status.release_values instead. Returned: always
